newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish net reserves fall to $21.98 bln in Aug 1-10.
newsitem.headline: Polish net reserves fall to $21.98 bln in Aug 1-10.

text.p: Polish net foreign currency reserves fell by $143.1 million in the August 1-10 period to $21.98 billion after a $580-million rise in July, and were $1.54 billion higher than in December 1995, the central bank said.
POLISH RESERVES (bln dollars) AUGUST 1-10 JULY DECEMBER 95
NOTE - Figures in billions of dollars. Official reserves are those held by the state. Net reserves mean the total amount of hard currencies in the whole banking system.
